name: Flare stack / boom system with knockout drum, seal drum, flare tips, pilots and ignition
description: Safely disposes of relieved and waste gas from PSVs and shutdowns. Header routes gas to a KO (vapour-liquid separator) drum, then a water/liquid seal drum preventing flashback, then an elevated stack or ground flare with pilots and continuous ignition. Stack height or boom reach is set by permissible thermal radiation.
